messages:
ana: Usability call summary: users want faster access to Stop when streaming and a compact token pill that doesn't steal focus. Attached short video. drew: Re: focus, we should move keyboard focus to Stop at stream start and trap focus in the small overlay if they stop. That avoids extra tabbing. kevin: Agree. Also propose shortcut: press Esc to stop, R to regenerate, Shift+R to rewind 20 tokens. Add small tooltip with shortcuts on hover. sasha: Accessibility rules: Stop should be a real button (role=button) and get aria-live announcement: "Generation started" then move focus. Token pill must be aria-hidden and budget updates broadcast via sr-only region. ana: Copy tweak: button label "Stop" not "Pause" (users confused). Tooltip: "Stop generation (Esc)". Token pill visible text: "Tokens: 512" and sr-only: "Streaming, 512 tokens. Budget: 2500 tokens." drew: Visual placement: pill sits right of toolbar but DOM order has controls first, then chat output, then token pill for a11y. That matches keyboard flow. kevin: Quick code sketch I'll add to PR playground/stream-shortcuts: ```
…
Tokens: 512
Generation started
``` sasha: Minor: use assertive for the initial start and polite for ongoing counts. Add role=dialog + aria-modal for stop overlay. Also ensure shortcut hints are in accessible tooltip components. ana: Prompt library tweak: add keyboard shortcut to open ("P") and focus first item. Allow pin/unpin via Enter and announce pinned state. drew: We'll prototype shortcuts + focus behavior behind a feature flag and run another small test. kevin: Will open PR and tag @sasha for a11y review and @ana for copy review. :rocket:
